clue.text: Live in, like a monk?

explanation.surface: A question about whether living somewhere resembles a monk's life.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell in a place is to occupy it; a monk wears a robe called a habit, so he is literally 'in habit'.

clue.text: Prophet is hard about road before one

indicators.note: the first pair of pieces wraps around the next pair, so 'about' signals a container

parts.note: taken as written
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

indicators.note: the road piece is placed ahead of the next piece in the answer

parts.note: the A1 is Britain's longest trunk road, written AI in crosswords
A means one, as in 'a book'

explanation.surface: A biblical seer is described as tough on the subject of a road ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: IS + H wraps around AI (the A1 road) followed by A (one).
explanation.definitionFit: He is one of the major Old Testament prophets, with a book of the Bible in his name.

clue.text: Japanese manufacturer is a success with a Greek character

parts.note: a hit is a success
chi is the 22nd letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Japanese company is said to be a hit thanks to a Greek letter.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' before 'success' belongs to HIT; the second 'a' gives the A in the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: The electronics and engineering group is a well-known company from Japan.

clue.text: We hear male's a listener to pirate

indicators.note: the clue tells us the pieces are to be heard spoken, so their sound gives the spelling

parts.note: a buck is a male deer, then 'a', then an ear is the organ of listening

explanation.surface: Someone claims a man who listens well is in fact a sea raider.
explanation.walkthrough: BUCK (male) + A + EAR (listener), said together, sound like the word for a pirate.
explanation.definitionFit: Buccaneers were the freebooters who raided Spanish ships in the Caribbean.

clue.text: Will such movement be showing an unnatural ability?

definitions.text: Will such movement be showing an unnatural ability?

parts.words: Will such movement be showing an unnatural ability?
parts.note: 'Will' is the faculty of the mind: movement brought about by will alone, without touching, would be a paranormal power

explanation.surface: A question about whether a certain kind of motion reveals a supernatural gift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' reads as the auxiliary verb but is the noun: moving objects by willpower.
explanation.definitionFit: The term names the supposed psychic power of moving objects by thought alone.

clue.text: Man is mad about awful ref

indicators.note: the word for mad wraps around the jumbled letters

parts.note: wild means mad, frenzied

indicators.note: an awful version of the word is a mangled one, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A football fan rants that a terrible referee has driven him crazy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts FRE (the anagram of REF, from 'awful') inside WILD.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name stands as an example of a man in crossword convention.

clue.text: Crude about hostility

indicators.note: turned about, the word for crude is read from its last letter back

parts.note: raw means crude, unrefined

explanation.surface: Rough behaviour regarding animosity.
explanation.definitionFit: Open conflict between nations is the most extreme form of hostility.

clue.text: Secure English philosopher

parts.note: to lock is to secure

explanation.surface: An English thinker is described as safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'English' looks like part of the definition but supplies E.
explanation.definitionFit: John Locke was the seventeenth-century empiricist thinker behind the idea of the mind as a blank slate.

clue.text: Knock traitor suppressing farewell

indicators.note: the word for traitor holds down and keeps inside the farewell word

parts.note: a rat is a traitor or informer
ta-ta is an informal British goodbye

explanation.surface: A disloyal person stifles a goodbye.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suppressing' puts TATA inside RAT, after RA.
explanation.definitionFit: The sound of repeated rapping on a door imitates a knock.

clue.text: No longer extant aims where you can't get through

parts.note: dead means no longer living or existing
ends are goals or aims

explanation.surface: Extinct goals are those which lead nowhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Cul-de-sacs or blocked passages offer no way through.

clue.text: Curtail new artist's backing of joint

indicators.note: a new version of the word is a rearranged one
the artist's letters are read back to front

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is a crossword artist

explanation.surface: Instructions to cut short a fresh painter's support for a body part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns CURTAIL into ARTICUL; 'backing' turns RA into AR.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things relating to the joints of the body.

clue.text: Company dry a garment worn in church

parts.note: TT, teetotal, means not drinking, so dry

explanation.surface: A firm that bans alcohol supplies a church vestment.
explanation.definitionFit: A cotta is a short surplice worn by clergy and choristers.

clue.text: Electricity supply damaged car in African capital

parts.note: AC, alternating current, is the mains electricity supply

indicators.note: a damaged form of the word is broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A car is wrecked by an electrical fault in an African city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' turns CAR into CRA, after AC.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the capital city of Ghana.

clue.text: Could such garish apparel be an obligation for the sleeper?

parts.note: someone having a kip is a kipper, one who sleeps
a tie is a binding obligation

explanation.surface: Whether a loud item of clothing could be a duty for someone asleep.
explanation.walkthrough: A kipper tie is a very wide, often loudly patterned 1960s-70s necktie.
explanation.definitionFit: Wide, flamboyant neckwear is a showy item of clothing.

clue.text: Leave evil and drink with good co-operative performance

parts.note: to part is to leave
sin is evil
gin is a drink

explanation.surface: Advice to give up wickedness and drink, with a moral, as a joint act.
explanation.definitionFit: Singing in harmony by several voices is a group musical performance.

clue.text: Displaying desperation beg to have chest thrust forward?

indicators.note: the words are shown in a fresh arrangement, a display of their letters reordered

explanation.surface: A desperate beggar pushes their chest out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Displaying' rearranges DESPERATION and BEG. 'to have' links; the definition describes the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A chest that protrudes like a bird's breastbone is the medical sense of the condition.

clue.text: Article was voluble about one being pained

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: the talk word goes around the letter for one

parts.note: gushed means talked effusively
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Something talked endlessly about a person in pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I inside GUSHED, after AN.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in anguish is in great distress or pain.

clue.text: Decapitated corpse's possible uses for old traveller

indicators.note: with its head removed, the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a body is a corpse

indicators.note: a possible arrangement of the letters is one rearranging them

explanation.surface: Gruesome uses for a headless corpse found by an ancient voyager.
explanation.walkthrough: BODY'S loses its head to make ODYS; 'possible' rearranges USES into SEUS.
explanation.definitionFit: The hero of Homer's epic spent ten years wandering home from Troy.

clue.text: Indication for barber to commence work, given by one in dire straits?

definitions.text: Indication for barber to commence work
given by one in dire straits?

explanation.surface: A sign sent to a hairdresser, or by someone in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense reads the phrase as 'dis-tress' signal: a cue to remove tresses.
explanation.definitionFit: A cue to take off someone's tresses; also an SOS or flare sent by people in danger.

clue.text: Observe attendant's failure to hold liquor

parts.note: to see is to observe
a page is an attendant

explanation.surface: A drunk servant noticed being unable to handle drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaking liquid out through a container is a failure to keep it in.

clue.text: One in advanced model designed as is the fashion

indicators.note: one letter goes inside the rearranged letters
designed means newly arranged, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: A means one

explanation.surface: A single person in a cutting-edge fashion model's outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges MODEL; 'in' places A inside it, giving LAMODE after the first A.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase means fashionable, in keeping with current style.

clue.text: Game time at Irish place

parts.note: Ennis is the county town of Clare in Ireland

explanation.surface: A match is played at an Irish town.
explanation.definitionFit: Racket sport played over a net, an example of a game.

clue.text: Writer and saint attending short service

indicators.note: cut short, the word loses its last letter

parts.note: evensong is an evening church service

explanation.surface: An author and a holy man go to a brief church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts EVENSONG to EVENSON.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert Louis Stevenson wrote Treasure Island.

clue.text: To invest with qualities to last-not right

indicators.note: the word for last is taken without the letter for right

parts.note: to endure is to last

explanation.surface: Grant some virtue that will survive, but not the right one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes R from ENDURE.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to endow or furnish someone with a gift or attribute.

clue.text: I make appraisal in anger

parts.note: to rate is to assess or appraise

explanation.surface: Someone assesses things while furious.
explanation.definitionFit: Being furious is being angry.

clue.text: Animal from eastern country?

parts.note: a land is a country

explanation.surface: Asking whether a creature comes from a land in the east.
explanation.definitionFit: The eland is a large African antelope, an example of an animal.

clue.text: A descent, we hear, to prove burdensome

indicators.note: the phrase is to be heard, its spoken sound giving another spelling

parts.note: a way down is a route that descends

explanation.surface: Reports of a downward path that turns out to be a heavy load.
explanation.definitionFit: To press heavily on someone is to be a burden.

clue.text: Some follow a youthful path

indicators.note: only some of the letters in the phrase are used, a run inside it

explanation.surface: A few people take a young person's route.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across follo(W A Y)outhful.
explanation.definitionFit: A route or road taken is a way.

clue.text: Cry seen to be made right in background?

indicators.note: the words must be put right, sorted into proper order from a jumble

explanation.surface: A shout witnessed needs correcting in a hidden context.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be made right' rearranges CRY and SEEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Stage sets and landscape form the backdrop behind the action.

clue.text: Dodges round second divine female

indicators.note: turning the word round mixes its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone evades a holy woman for a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' rearranges DODGES into GODDES, then S.
explanation.definitionFit: A deity of the female sex is a goddess-figure such as Athena.
